name: Trudne Sprawy
source:
Explore the story of Alan, high schooler from Poland, struggling against murderers, dark forces and his own friends.
Friendship, love, sacrifice, brotherhood, alcohol, drugs, sex and anal adventures. These whole stuff and more lie within compelling storyline of the game.
